findings.problem: With no hint, "constantly" can just as well be answered with the common everyday synonyms dauernd or andauernd, so the prompt has more than one right answer.

back.target: constantly, all the time (as an adjective: constant, permanent)
back.example: You're always coming late. / You're constantly late.

note: Ständig is also used as an adjective (eine ständige Gefahr), but presenting it as an adverb fits the prompt and the example.
